text:
Anya: quick sync we need a lightweight carve-up + triage rubric for SI co-sell leads coming from marketplace/hw partners. can we agree on a small set of rules so reps and SI PMs don't fight over claims?
Tom: yes please. current problem: reps are grabbing anything demo-ready. how do we gate? :eyes:
Liam: proposal from the SI side prefer leads where customer already has infra intent (cloud commit or HW RFP). SI takes >$250k ARR both current + forecast, otherwise rotate back to field.
Maya: revops suggestion use a 3-band mapping so it's deterministic: Band A (>$250k) = SI-first, Band B ($50-250k) = shared + 48h claim window, Band C (<$50k) = field-only. we can enforce via CRM tag + automated claim task.
Anya: solid. can we add "no-claim" tags for accounts with active pilot runbooks or legal review where SI can't engage until legal clears?
Tom: +1. also want a rule for inbound sourced by partner sales vs partner marketing net-new. inbound via partner sales should default to partner unless rep has explicit motion.
Liam: agreed on partner-sourced default. we also need mapping for named accounts vs open-market. for named accounts, priority goes to the owning AE unless they opt-in to SI assistance.
Maya: putting it in a compact checklist helps adoption. draft checklist below — RevOps can implement automation.
Maya: ```
- Identify source: partner_sales | partner_marketing | marketplace
- Map ARR band -> assignment (A/B/C)
- If partner_sales => auto-assign to SI queue, AE notified
- Named account & AE-owned => AE retains unless "si_optin" checkbox checked
- Active legal/pilot => add no-claim tag -> hold routing
- 48h claim window for Band B, then auto-escalate to AE queue
```
Anya: can we add an SLA for initial outreach from SI (48 hours for Band A, 72 for Band B)?
Liam: yes 48h for A makes sense. we'll log first-touch activity via CRM note.
Tom: what about crediting / compensation? we need a simple split so sales operations can calculate commission. maybe 70/30 for SI-sourced closed-won on Band A?
Maya: comp splits should be in a separate doc but we can tag the win with "si_split_70_30" metadata for downstream processing. OpsBot can emit events.
OpsBot: reminder: please use the pipeline tag schema: partner_source, arr_band, si_claim_status. automation rules will look for these exact tags.
Anya: ok next steps — Maya to implement tag schema + automation, Liam to draft SI-facing intake email and outreach SLA template, Tom to confirm comp baseline with sales ops, I'll pull together a short one-pager for GTM teams. any objections?
Tom: none from me.
Liam: no objections. i'll start the intake email draft and ping for review.
Maya: I'll spin up the CRM rule and a small playbook page in Confluence. ETA EOD Friday.
Anya: perfect. thanks all :rocket:
